title: Supporting Child Healing
description: This module helps parents understand how domestic and family violence affects children emotionally, behaviourally, and developmentally. It provides practical, age‑appropriate strategies to support children’s healing, resilience, and sense of safety.
outcomes: Understand how DFV impacts children at different developmental stages
Provide age‑appropriate emotional support to children recovering from DFV
Strengthen children’s resilience and sense of safety
